execution_part.Description: The instruction truncates a 64-bit floating-point number to an unsigned 64-bit integer using saturation (clamping within the target range). If the conversion is within range, the result is pushed onto the stack.
The instruction attempts to truncate a NaN floating-point number. The result is 0, which is pushed onto the stack.
The instruction attempts to truncate an infinite floating-point number. The result is the maximum unsigned 64-bit integer value, which is pushed onto the stack.

The instruction attempts to truncate a floating-point number that is too large to be represented as an unsigned 64-bit integer. The result is the maximum unsigned 64-bit integer value, which is pushed onto the stack.
The instruction attempts to truncate a negative floating-point number. The result is 0, which is pushed onto the stack.
